name: Mini-Splatting
aliases: Representing Scenes with a Constrained Number of Gaussians
definition: Explicitly constrains the total number of Gaussians by imposing a hard limit N_max and formulating optimization as a mixed integer problem to bound memory footprints.
summary: Mini-Splatting is a resource-efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting method that constrains the total number of Gaussians to a hard limit, achieving reduced memory and faster training through spatial reorganization rather than direct simplification.
